children: According to ChainCatcher citing Serenity, IREN's earnings report and Rosenblatt research, some neocloud providers, including NBIS, look attractive after a sharp valuation decline. Serenity said companies with close ties to suppliers such as NVIDIA, contracted capacity, necessary permits, well-funded partners and affordable equipment financing may remain well-positioned.

Serenity cited IREN's report that advance payments under a five-year agreement can cover 90% of GPU capital expenditures, showing listed neocloud providers can adapt to tight financing. It also noted that re-contracting prices for older H100 GPUs reached twice their previous level, countering some concerns about equipment depreciation. Rosenblatt research described NBIS's major projects in Missouri, Pennsylvania and South Carolina as low-risk. Serenity said tighter financing and potential permit restrictions could disadvantage new entrants and strengthen the competitive edge of established providers.

title: Serenity Says Financing and Potential Permit Limits Could Strengthen Select Neocloud Firms
